description: Apps that do the same job as the given app, in three groups: most_similar (S to C tier; apps that also sit in more of this app's other categories first, then the same App Store genre, then tier), top_rated (the category's own order) and best_free (free to download, in-app purchases allowed); each app in one group at most, every one with why it is there (shared_lists, same_genre, free). all lists every alternative. They all come from the app's main-job category, so none does a different job. An app whose missing_since is set is no longer on the App Store: its alternatives matter most then.
name: find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to an app
